pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-04.png with Read and looked at it. Panel 1 (wide, top): caption at top left, 'Soon, his slot comes up.', then the label at top right, 'NOW · A-12'. Ravi is near the centre and Meera at the far right; both are silent. Panel 2 (tall, bottom left): caption 'A quick vitals check first.', then the nurse's balloon, 'Hi, Ravi! Just relax your arm for me.' Ravi is at lower left and silent. Panel 3 (tall, bottom right): caption 'Dr. Ananya is notified when he's ready.' Ananya is in the middle and silent. A label near the bottom reads 'RAVI · READY'.
pages.observation: Reading order is clear. 'his slot' relies on the reader having inferred on page 3 that Ravi is A-12. Ravi does not reply to the nurse. That works as a silent cooperation beat, but his reaction or posture must show it in the art. The 'RAVI · READY' label breaks after the dot ('RAVI ·' / 'READY'), which looks awkward and could be set on one line. In panel 3, the label sits far below Ananya, at the bottom of a mostly empty tall panel, so the eye has to travel a long way. Meera's role in panel 1 is unclear because she is silent and tiny at the edge. It is also unclear whether she is calling the slot or just present. All text is legible.
